newsitem.title: DUBAI: New Oman equity fund targets new issues.
newsitem.headline: New Oman equity fund targets new issues.

text.p: A new equity fund that will invest mainly in Omani primary issues has been launched to take advantage of the string of companies being listed on the booming Muscat Securities Market (MSM).
International investment advisers HSBC Financial Services said the three-year close-ended First Mazoon Fund would be managed by Oman brokerage Gulf Investment Services.

"The actual size of the fund is targeted at 10 million rials, but depending on investors' appetite it could go up to 15 million," HSBC Financial Services Middle East chief executive Mukhtar Hussain told Reuters.
Eight founder shareholders had already committed 4.5 million rials to the issue, which is being offered at 1.020 rials and closes on June 10.
Earlier this month MSM executive president Mahmoud al-Jarwani said all 12 initial public offerings so far this year had been oversubscribed. He expected a total of 20 to 25 new issues during 1997.
"The new issues market has been an attractive one and the signs for that continuing are encouraging," Hussain said.
"The fund will provide investors with the opportunity to participate in a variety of new issues without the need for individual assessment and subscription," he said.
The fund is open to 49 percent foreign ownership.
